bead.title: claude-tui: shutdown orphan reaper for live PTY children (SIGTERM then SIGKILL)
bead.description:
PROBLEM: ADR-013 §3 (decision item 6, orphan reaper) requires that PTY child processes left alive be reaped on harness shutdown within a bounded timeout, escalating SIGTERM to SIGKILL, so a terminating fiz process does not leak orphaned `claude` PTY children.

ROOT CAUSE:
- internal/harnesses/claude-tui/harness.go:36-149 — the Harness exposes no Shutdown method (only Info/HealthCheck/Execute/Quota/Account/ModelDiscovery), so pooled PTY children are never terminated and nothing enumerates live PTY children at teardown.
- internal/pty/session/types.go:276,293,309 — Session.Close/Kill/Wait exist but are not driven from any harness-level shutdown path; the process-group kill at internal/pty/session/session_unix.go:122-134 is invoked only on context cancel, not on harness teardown.

PROPOSED FIX:
1. Add Harness.Shutdown(ctx) that enumerates the pool's live PTY sessions and reaps each within a bounded timeout: send SIGTERM (Session.Close), then escalate to SIGKILL (Session.Kill) if Session.Wait does not return before the deadline.
2. The reaper inspects live session state only — no persistent or cross-invocation state (ADR-013 §3 item 6).

NON-SCOPE:
- The session pool data structure, reuse, and `/clear`-between-turns logic (sibling child in this decomposition).
- The startup cross-invocation reaper analogous to service_stale_harness_reaper*.go — this bead is the in-process shutdown reaper only.
- The PTY turn driver and intermediate ProgressEvent emission (sibling child A).
- AccountHarness and QuotaHarness implementations (sibling child C).
- Performance benchmarking and 2x/10ms ratchets (sibling child D).
- ModelDiscoveryHarness and no-static-fallback enforcement.
- Capability baseline rows, evidence IDs, ADR-013 status promotion.
- Cassette-driven static fallback for production code (forbidden by fizeau-89eca738).
- Service-side changes beyond what child #1 already wired.
- Redesigning the hook-conflict arbitration layer.

Depends on the sibling session-pool child of this decomposition, child #1, and sibling child A. Governing artifacts: ADR-013 §3 (decision item 6), CONTRACT-004, internal/pty/ library.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestClaudeTuiOrphanReaper asserts that on harness Shutdown any leftover PTY child processes are reaped within a bounded timeout (SIGTERM then escalated SIGKILL).
2) go test ./... -count=1 is green.
3) lefthook run pre-commit is green.
